fill: next H1 open after a signal on a closed H1. Forming last H1 excluded.
signals: BtcTrendPullback grammar, closed H1 only. HTF from completed H4 only (H4 open + 14400s <= H1 open).
weekend: flatten_weekend frozen true. No new fill on Friday last H1. Open trades exit at that open. Swap unmodeled.

causality.completed_bars: EMA / RSI / MACD / ATR / setups use completed H1 including i. Last series bar is forming (exclude_forming).
causality.htf_join: Native H4.hc. CompletedHtfShift: last H4 with open+14400 <= H1 open. Do not resample H1 into UTC buckets. Do not use forming H4 close.
causality.htf_bias: +1 if completed H4 close>EMA200 and EMA50>EMA200 and (EMA50-EMA200)/EMA200 >= 0.01. Mirror for -1. Else 0 (chop).
causality.ema: EMA50/200 on H1 close; EMA50/200 on completed H4 close. Seed SMA then recursive EMA (ema_series).
causality.macd: MACD 12/26/9 hist = macd - signal on H1 close (macd_series).
causality.atr: Wilder ATR14 on H1 (wilder_atr). atr_pct = atr[i]/close[i]. Floor 0.01.
causality.edge_trigger: setup now AND NOT setup on previous closed H1.
causality.panic_block: longs vetoed if (RSI<=35 or atr_pct>=0.08) and close<H1 EMA200. Shorts mirrored.
causality.entry_close: decision on close[i]; fill is open[i+1].
causality.gap: if the next H1 open gaps through SL or TP, exit at that open (SL before TP if both).
causality.pivots: not used. Do not import htf_fib_core for this family. BtcTrendPullback is EMA/RSI/MACD reclaim, not Fib.
